summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC (the technology behind video calls) in Firefox involve improvements to how audio data is processed. Specifically, the handling of audio packets has been refined by ensuring that the system correctly calculates sample counts while returning errors more consistently. This is crucial for maintaining high-quality audio in real-time communication, which directly impacts user experiences during calls. By enhancing the reliability of audio data processing, these changes help ensure smoother and clearer conversations, making **video calls more dependable and enjoyable** for users.
